description.en: Returns a player's spirit lock flag (a flag of the player's record; by the name, a locked spirit cannot be changed). RunAttachAvatarEx saves it, unlocks the spirit to attach a new one, then restores it.

true if locked, false if not or if the handle is 0 or invalid.
null if the script system is not ready or no argument is given.

examples.case: Attaching a spirit (real code, from ie4_ev_main.nut, RunAttachAvatarEx)
